messages:
nina: Quick announcement: SDK v4.2 will remove the old boolean config `enable_legacy_retry`. We're publishing a migration guide + a short-lived compatibility shim. Please review and plan any infra/template changes.

sam: Is the shim on by default or opt-in?

nina: Opt-in via env var `REDWOOD_COMPAT_LEGACY_RETRY=1`. Shim translates the boolean into the new `retry` object at init. Intended for emergency use only (90-day window).

leo: Can you paste the new canonical example so infra teams can update templates?

nina: Sure: `{ "retry": { "strategy": "exponential", "max_retries": "3", "backoff_ms": "200" } }` — full examples + tests in the doc.

docs-bot: Migration doc published: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/sdk/migration/legacy-retry-sunset. Changelog entry pushed to /sdk/v4.2.

sam: Release plan? canary and rollback criteria?

nina: Canary 5% for 48h, 25% for 24h, then full. Rollback if 5xx >2x baseline for 30m or p95 latency increases by >200ms.

leo: We'll add telemetry counters for shim usage and a linter rule to warn on `enable_legacy_retry` now and fail after 2025-07-01.

sam: I'll coordinate customer comms for Dedicated/Private.

nina: Thanks — please post migration blockers in #docs-migration. Closing once changelog email goes out.
